name: Luồng 6 - Daily Executive Intelligence & Incident Spike Alert (12 Nodes)

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_triage_logs WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS total_emails_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_quarantine_vault WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS spam_blocked_today;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RESOLVED' OR status = 'CLOSED') AS resolved_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority ILIKE '%P1%') AS p1_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS pending_tickets, COALESCE(ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RESOLVED' OR status = 'CLOSED')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric) * 100, 2), 100.0) AS sla_compliance_rate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE priority ILIKE '%P1%' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE) AS p1_past_7_days FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

Detect Incident Spike Code').first().json; const aiResp = $input.first().json; let parsed = {}; if (aiResp && aiResp.candidates && aiResp.candidates[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text) { try { parsed = JSON.parse(aiResp.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text); } catch (e) {} } const summaryText = parsed.executive_summary || `Hệ thống tiếp nhận tổng cộng ${metrics.total_emails_today} email trong ngày ${metrics.summary_date}. ${metrics.is_spike_detected ? ` ` : ''}
